goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь сказать, где ты был и каким был день, с was и were.
can_do_en: I can say where I was and what it was like using was and were.

words.en: at home / at school / at a friend's
words.example_en: I was at a friend's house.

words.en: at the cinema / at the match
words.example_en: We were at the match on Sunday.
words.example_ru: В воскресенье мы были на матче.

grammar.title_ru: Past Simple глагола be: was / were
grammar.explain_ru: am и is в прошлом → was; are → were. I was, he/she/it was; you/we/they were. Отрицание: wasn't, weren't. Вопрос: Where were you? Was it fun? — Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't. Маркеры прошлого: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago, in 2020.
grammar.explain_en: am/is → was, are → were. I was at home. They were at school. Was it fun? — Yes, it was. Where were you yesterday?

examples.en: Where were you yesterday? — I was at the olympiad.
examples.ru: Где ты был вчера? — На олимпиаде.

examples.en: The tasks were hard, but it was interesting.
examples.ru: Задачи были сложные, но было интересно.

examples.en: I was born in Chelyabinsk in 2011.

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Первый урок прошлого — только be. Привязка: am/is → was, are → were. Годы: twenty eleven, two thousand and nine. Тема — где был на выходных, на олимпиаде, на матче.

phrases.en: It was great / OK / a disaster.

questions_en: Where were you yesterday at six?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Детективная игра: Нейт — следователь, «пропал торт», ученик даёт алиби: I was at… with…

tasks.question: My friends ___ at the cinema yesterday.

tasks.ask_ru: Вставь was, were, wasn't или weren't.
tasks.text: ___ you at school yesterday? — No, I ___. I ___ ill.

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай без текста. Где была Кейт в субботу?
tasks.audio: On Saturday I wasn't at home. I was at a football match with my dad. It was cold and the stadium was crowded, but the match was amazing!
tasks.question: Где была Кейт?

tasks.text: Вчера я был на олимпиаде. Задачи были трудные.
answers: Yesterday I was at the olympiad. The problems were hard.
I was at the olympiad yesterday. The tasks were difficult.

tasks.ask_ru: Фотографии из телефона с датами. Расскажи, где был этот человек и как там было.

image.prompt_en: Three phone photo cards with small date stickers: a crowded stadium (Saturday), a quiet library (Monday), a rainy beach (last summer), flat illustration with tiny calendar icons, no words
image.alt_ru: Три фото: людный стадион (суббота), тихая библиотека (понедельник), пляж под дождём (прошлым летом).

tasks.say: Where was he? What was it like?
tasks.example: On Saturday he was at a stadium. It was crowded. On Monday he was at the library. It was quiet. Last summer he was at the beach, but the weather was awful.

tasks.ask_ru: Детектив: из учительской пропал торт! Нейт — следователь. Дай алиби: где ты был вчера с 3 до 6, с кем, что там было.
tasks.opening: Somebody ate the teachers' cake yesterday. Where were you at three o'clock?
goals_ru: ответить на Was it…? / Were you…?
example: T: Where were you at three o'clock?
L: No, I wasn't. My sister was at home too.
L: We were at the gym. It was crowded!

tasks.ask_ru: Расскажи, где ты был в прошлые выходные и как там было.
tasks.say: So. How was your weekend? Where were you?
tasks.example: My weekend was OK. On Saturday I was at my grandma's. It was boring. On Sunday I was at the cinema with friends. The film was amazing.

homework.about_ru: Запиши голосом «дневник за 3 дня»: где ты был вчера, позавчера и неделю назад и как там было.

tasks.ask_ru: Где ты был в разные дни.
tasks.say: Yesterday, two days ago, last week — where were you?
tasks.example: Yesterday I was at school and then at home. Two days ago I was at the robotics club. Last week I was ill — I wasn't at school.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в рассказе о выходных (t9) was/were без ошибок.

review.note_ru: Чувства (tired, happy) и места города — в прошлом.
